deadline_text_verbatim: Each year you can apply via UCAS from early September for entry the following year. For example, if you want to begin studying in September 2026, you can apply from 2 September 2025.
limitations: Application OPENING date, not a closing deadline. The 2026 cycle has closed; retained per the lane's rule that a real published date for a closed cycle stops a later pass from rediscovering it and mistaking it for live.

deadline_text_verbatim: The final deadline for international student applications is 30 June 2026. However, there is also an equal consideration deadline on 14 January 2026 (6pm, UK time)
limitations: This is Manchester's RESTATEMENT of the platform-wide UCAS equal consideration deadline, not a Manchester-set date. Per coordination DECISION 1 (2026-08-21), UCAS is the primary authority for its own platform deadlines and a university's restatement is a copy. 14 January 2026 was correct for the 2026 cycle; the 2027-cycle equivalent is already recorded from UCAS's own dated event pages in deadlines_batch3. Do NOT roll this date forward.

deadline_text_verbatim: The final deadline for international student applications is 30 June 2026.

deadline_text_verbatim: If you're applying for Medicine or Dentistry courses, the deadline is 15 October 2026 (6pm, UK time) for September 2024 entry.
limitations:
SELF-CONTRADICTING SOURCE. One sentence on one official page binds the date 15 October 2026 to 'September 2024 entry'. Those cannot both be true: 15 October 2026 is the October deadline for 2027 entry, and September 2024 entry closed on 16 October 2023. The rest of the same page is written for September 2026 entry, so the page is internally inconsistent in two directions at once. deadline_date and cycle_year are left NULL: any value here would be this lane choosing which half of the sentence to believe, which is exactly the silent resolution the evidence standard forbids. The authoritative 2027-entry October date is UCAS's own dated event page, already recorded in deadlines_batch3.

RESOLUTION 2026-08-22 (see docs/research/requirement-conflicts/01-manchester-medicine-entry-year.md): RESOLVED externally, without choosing a half of the sentence. UCAS receives UK undergraduate applications and publishes this deadline as a dated cycle event: 18:00 UK on 15 October 2026 for 2027 entry, for Oxbridge and most medicine/veterinary/dentistry courses (UCAS event page, already VERIFIED_CURRENT in deadlines_batch3). The DATE on Manchester's page is therefore correct; the ENTRY YEAR is not — it governs September 2027 entry, and September 2024 entry closed 16 October 2023. deadline_date and cycle_year filled from UCAS. SECOND FINDING, unchanged: re-fetched 2026-08-22 and the page is verbatim identical, still self-contradicting, still undated. A student reading it today is still misled, so this page must NOT be cited as the source for this date. verification_state left CONFLICTING_EVIDENCE because the source remains broken even though the fact is settled.

Checked, not missed. As of 2026-08-21 Manchester's international undergraduate application-process page carries only 2026-entry dates (DL-9001 to DL-9003) plus the self-contradicting row DL-9004.
